messages:
maya: weekend poll — thinking of heading to the Kyoto food fair on Sunday (11am) or hosting a tiny potluck at my place. open invite! which would you pick? :sushi: :bento: :sparkles:
sam: kyoto food fair for me if anyone wants to meet up and train there. also less dishes for me :joy:
devon: potluck!! i'll bring my famous potato salad and a giant thermos of chili :potato: :chili_pepper:
lisa: potluck > food fair. can swing by after my spin class. what time were you thinking maya? :raised_hands:
akira: both sound great but i'll be out of town. if you go to the fair, try the okonomiyaki by the river — chef there has a killer sauce. also fyi there's a tiny vintage stall near the second gate.
maya: @lisa maybe 5pm? easy for people to come after afternoon plans. @sam if you want to meet at the station at 10:30 for the fair that works too.
sam: 10:30 train meetup sounds good to me. will bring my camera for pics. :camera_with_flash:
maya: poll time: react with :one: for Kyoto fair, :two: for potluck. leaving it open til Sat noon.
calendar-bot: FYI — team lunch is scheduled Monday 12:00 PM in the main conference room. (posted so folks don't double-book)
lisa: :two: — bringing a dessert if potluck wins :cake:
devon: :two: 100%
akira: enjoy y'all! take pics if you do the fair :sparkles:
